subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 One some mice were having good time in a big house. They were doing a lot of mischief there. The owner of the house was very annoyed and made a plan to get rid of it...........................
guide_solution: Story writing  Title : Who is to Bell the Cat? See Rajuk Uttara Model College, Dhaka. Sl. No. 13; Page No. 59
